category_feedback.specific_evidence: expanded_walkthrough.recovery_moves = ['Overlap test.', 'Drill BOTH.', 'Compare same-size vs different-size.'] — three terse imperatives with no diagnostic branching and no research grounding for the size-blind congruence trap.
category_feedback.required_fix: Branch recovery by what the diagnostic told you: (a) if the child can name 'same shape' but freezes on size, drop to a side-by-side ruler/tracing paper measure to make size visible; (b) if the child confuses 'congruent' with 'similar', name the contrast explicitly and overlap to show non-match; (c) if the child accepts any two same-named shapes, return to the cube-faces demo. Cite the research basis (e.g., Battista 2007 on spatial reasoning levels, or van Hiele Level 1 visual-only reasoning) in expanded_walkthrough.rationale.

category_feedback.specific_evidence: lesson_specific_materials require 'Congruent Face Match Cards (1 set per pair)' and 'Tracing paper'; differentiation.for_ell_or_iep = 'Tracing paper to overlap.' — no no-paper, no-purchase alternative path is offered for days when prep wasn't possible.
category_feedback.required_fix: Add an explicit NO-MATERIALS alternative in differentiation: e.g., 'No-paper version — children use their own two hands (palms together for congruent; one palm + one fist for not-congruent), or trace shapes from classroom objects (book covers, tile floor, window panes) and compare by laying one on top of the other. Body/voice carries the same overlap test.'

category_feedback.required_fix: In expanded_walkthrough.rationale, name the misconception in research-grounded terms — e.g., 'This is a van Hiele Level 1 (visual) error: children attend to shape category but not metric attributes, a documented Grade-3 transition difficulty (Battista 2007).'
